s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive subcutaneous node in the axilla with skin infiltration and episodic pain
salient_findings: Slowly growing subcutaneous node in the right axilla
Progressive infiltration of the overlying skin
Erythematous plaque in the right axilla measuring 5 × 3 cm
Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
Tumor cells with basophilic nuclei and scant cytoplasm in an 'Indian file pattern'
key_facts: Female patient in her 60s
Subcutaneous node in the right axilla first noticed 10 years ago
Progressive infiltration of the overlying skin over the past year
Swelling in the right axilla during pregnancy over 20 years ago
Mild episodic pain in the right axilla during menstrual cycles
Solitary, indolent, erythematous plaque in the right axilla measuring 5 × 3 cm
Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
Tumor cells diffusely dispersed between collagen bundles
Tumor cells lined up in an 'Indian file pattern' with basophilic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Positive immunohistochemistry for pancytokeratin, cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies
Negative immunohistochemistry for synaptophysin, chromogranin, and S100-stainings
Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration
No evidence of primary or secondary tumors on chest, abdominal, and pelvic CT scans, cranial and breast MRI, mammography, and breast sonography

shortlist.label: Mammary analogue secretory carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive immunohistochemistry for GATA3 and estrogen receptor, and histopathology showing tumor cells in an 'Indian file pattern'

shortlist.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration

shortlist.label: Cutaneous metastasis of breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of swelling in the right axilla during pregnancy and mild episodic pain during menstrual cycles, suggesting possible hormonal influence

shortlist.label: Extramammary Paget's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary, indolent, erythematous plaque in the right axilla and positive immunohistochemistry for cytokeratin 20

shortlist.label: Sweat gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor cells diffusely dispersed between collagen bundles and positive immunohistochemistry for GCDFP15

raw.rationale: The tumor's histological features, including the 'Indian file pattern' and positive immunohistochemistry for pancytokeratin, cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies, are consistent with mammary analogue secretory carcinoma, a rare tumor that shares similarities with breast secretory carcinoma

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: While apocrine glands are present, the tumor's morphology and immunohistochemical profile are more consistent with mammary analogue secretory carcinoma

rejected.label: Cutaneous metastasis of breast cancer
rejected.why: No evidence of primary or secondary breast tumors on imaging studies

rejected.label: Extramammary Paget's disease
rejected.why: Lack of epidermal involvement and distinct immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: Sweat gland carcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor's features are more specific to mammary analogue secretory carcinoma than a general sweat gland carcinoma
